name: Entity References Finder
description: Admin report that lists which entity_reference / entity_reference_revisions field configurations target a selected content entity type and bundle.
project_description: This module makes it easy to find where a given entity type and bundle are targeted by entity reference fields. Select a content entity type and bundle and the report lists every entity_reference and entity_reference_revisions field configured to point at that bundle, showing the field name, the entity type that owns the field, and the owning bundle. Available at admin/reports/entity_reference_finder.
